criteria.name: S01
criteria.description: S01：Results前四列表头去除首尾空格后须为label、value、unit、source_note，大小写与顺序严格一致；允许后接额外列。表头不符扣3分并触发must_clause_cap，总分上限0.69；缺表或错表名单独归零。

criteria.name: S02
criteria.description: S02：每条必需结果单位严格为AUD million nominal；违反扣3分，并触发must_clause_cap（总分上限0.69）。

criteria.name: P01
criteria.description: Deduct for Excel error cells outside result cells already assessed

criteria.name: S03
criteria.description: S03：每条必需结果的来源引用非空且不是纯数字；违反扣3分，并触发must_clause_cap（总分上限0.69）。

criteria.name: S04
criteria.description: 三条必需结果按题面顺序从第2行排列，不得缺失、重复或逆序。

criteria.name: S05
criteria.description: S05：Results不得新增标签不在必需列表且带业务值的记录，违反扣3分并触发must_clause_cap。重复必需标签扣3分但不单独触发封顶；无业务值的文字备注和支持工作表不触发此项。

criteria.name: S06
criteria.description: S06：精度p=3；number_format显示p位，或存储值等于其四舍五入至p位的值，均合规；题面至少p位也接受存储小数位数不少于p。数值误差依各派生行容差单独判断。

criteria.name: L01
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: All source references in the candidate are verifiable against the provided materials. The Excel cell references (F61:F62, F64, F115:F116, F118, F169:F170, F172, L7:L8, L10, F282:F287, and all Working sheet row references) correspond to real cells containing relevant capex, disposal, contribution, forecast, and WACC/inflation data. The PDF reference to page 27, section 2.4.1 and footnote 20 is confirmed: page 27 contains section 2.4.1 titled 'Nominal adjustments for difference between actual and forecast net capex in final year' and footnote 20 discussing the nominal vanilla WACC. No fabricated files, pages, or tables detected.

criteria.name: L02
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。
criteria.reasoning: The candidate contains no claims of having completed external audits, real-time queries, or independent verification. All text is limited to source citations and numerical data presentation. No unsupported completion assertions are present.

criteria.name: L03
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: The candidate's explanatory text consists solely of source references and asset class labels that directly match the input Excel file contents. No additional company operating facts or business assertions are introduced beyond what is contained in the provided input materials. No fabricated factual claims detected.
